result.title: Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?
result.summary: Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Building on this analysis, we show that a single token-level KL anchor on the high tier is sufficient to learn separated tiers within one RL stage, and that natural-language effort instructions make this separation emerge from the start of training, yielding a policy competitive with multi-teacher OPD at matched thinking length. Finally, the separation built by dense targets holds only on the states seen in training: it does not carry over to unseen agentic tasks, where effort acts mainly through the number of interaction turns, whereas the compression induced by sequence-level rewards does.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告系统比较强化学习与多教师 on-policy distillation 在推理努力（thinking 长度）控制上的差异：长度惩罚 RL 能压缩单一策略但在联合训练时使档位塌缩，OPD 则在每个访问状态提供档位特定目标从而分离低/中/高档，并发现单一 token 级 KL 锚点与自然语言努力指令即可在单阶段 RL 中复现该分离，但稠密目标带来的分离无法迁移到未见 agentic 任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本研究，其「序列级奖励难以区分共享行为与档位行为、逐状态稠密目标才能塑造包括停止决策在内的行为」这一训练信号分析，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态监督与 THINK/STOP 预算控制的线索。
